dataset: AT&T/ORL Database of Faces, 40 subjects x 10 images

closed_set.protocol: stratified_kfold(k=5), all 400 images, every score is out-of-fold

open_set.setup: 30 enrolled x 6 images, 4 genuine probes each, 10 impostor subjects, 20 random subject splits (seeds 0..19); values = mean, std

liveness.method: ORL faces pasted at 200 px width into 640x480 frames, Gaussian noise sigma=4 + JPEG q80, Haar detector, 9 frames per face
liveness.note: slid_still_photo_passes counts how often a flat photo translated sideways satisfies the challenge. The rule measures face-box movement, so a translated flat image can satisfy it; this is a known limitation, not a defended attack.
